procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/lowndes/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (11/11).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 12); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 20 precincts (11 columns, then New Hope/Plum Grove/Rural Hill/Southside Church/Steens/Townsend Park/Trinity/University/West Lowndes + TOTAL); p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying Circuit 16 Place 3 and the locals. The section boundary fell cleanly (Circuit 16 Place 3's section opens table B with its own header; no carry). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 01-1st Congressional District (Johnny Baucom, Cliff Johnson, Trent Kelly -- the same House 1 roster six counties print, names identical); Chancery Court 14-2-Chancery District 14-2 (Joseph N. 'Joe' Studdard) and 14-3-Chancery District 14-3 (Paula Drungole-Ellis -- the same candidate Noxubee's portion of Chancery 14 elects; both sections' X-celled rows referee under their own printed TOTALs: Studdard 6609+6434 = 13043, Drungole-Ellis 1776+2060 = 3836); Circuit Court 16-Circuit District 16 Place 1 (James 'Jim' Thomas Kitchens Jr.), Place 2 (Lee J. 'Jay' Howard), Place 3 (Michelle Easterling) -- the same Circuit 16 roster Noxubee prints, names identical. NO Court of Appeals section prints on this sheet (no Lowndes precinct falls inside the appellate districts whose sections print elsewhere; the sheet's row stream starts at U.S. Senate). Printed totals: Colom 12568, Hyde-Smith 9008, Pinkins 243, Baucom 274, Johnson 11775, Kelly 9503, Studdard 13043, Drungole-Ellis 3836, Kitchens 16779, Howard 16520, Easterling 16462.
operator_rows_note: All 11 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (nine precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Easterling's row carries p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled judicial rows (Studdard, Drungole-Ellis) supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the twenty precinct headers print complete (Airbase, Artesia, Brandon, Caledonia, Coleman, Crawford, East Columbus Gym, Fifteenth Street Church, Hunt, Lion Hills, Lone Oak, New Hope, Plum Grove, Rural Hill, Southside Church, Steens, Townsend Park, Trinity, University, West Lowndes).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 16 Place 3: Lowndes-County Court Judge (Allison Pritchard Kizer) and School Board 5-County School Board District Five (Jacqueline 'Jackie' Givens Gray, Tresa B. Sanders) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 14's printed Places on THIS sheet are 2 and 3; Circuit 16's Places 1/2/3 print, so the family writes Place-qualified labels.

accepted_roster_divergences.note: Place spread across the district's counties: Lowndes' own recap prints Place 2 (Joseph N. 'Joe' Studdard) and the shared Place 3 (Paula Drungole-Ellis), whose identical printed roster also appears on Noxubee's sheet; Chickasaw's portion of Chancery 14 elects Place 1 only (Rodney P. Faver). Each county keeps its own printed sections; the family-level (seat-blind) gate's incomparable-roster record is accepted as printed-ballot place structure, not a reading error, with every row's arithmetic verified against its own sheet.
